rollforward.notes: All four A/B/P/E values read verbatim from the audited consolidated Distribution Statement (Group column), page 128. B (net_distributable_income = 1,638) is the genuine for-the-year subtotal ('Income for the year available for distribution'), computed in-statement as Total loss for the year attributable to Unitholders (1,818) + Distribution adjustments (Note A) 3,456; it does NOT fold in the opening carry (the cumulative-available trap was avoided). Simple guard A+B-P = 1,377,000 + 1,638,000 - 2,442,000 = 573,000, versus E = 409,000; discrepancy = 164,000. This gap is NOT a misread: it equals the DISCLOSED 'Amount retained' line of (164) (footnote 1: ~S$0.2M retained for operational expenses / working capital), which the simple identity omits. Full identity A + B - retained - P = 1,377,000 + 1,638,000 - 164,000 - 2,442,000 = 409,000 balances exactly to E. All figures as-disclosed; nothing computed or plugged. P (2,442) is cash actually paid during the year and crosses fiscal years (2H FY2024 tranche 1,299 + 1H FY2025 tranche 1,143), distinct from distribution_paid_declared for FY2025 (1,474, after retention, DPU 0.29c). Group and REIT columns agree on opening/for-year/closing (1,377 / 1,638 / 409).
